0022600212.text: Boston comes into this game at 8-2, second in the East and 0.5 games back of Philadelphia in the Atlantic, on a three-game winning streak with a 3-2 road record. The 76ers are 9-2, first in both the East and the Atlantic, on a one-game win streak with a 4-1 home record, and Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture) and Adem Bona (day-to-day, back sprain, game-time decision) are not available. The teams split 2-2 in the 2025-26 regular season and the Celtics lost 3-4 to Philadelphia in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 109-100 loss in Boston on May 2, 2026, and they have not played each other yet in 2026-27.
